create.name: Cristi Christensen
create.bio:
Cristi Christensen is a yoga teacher based in Los Angeles whose classes mix chakra work, dance, breath and live music. Before yoga she competed as a gymnast and platform diver and trained alongside the US Olympic diving squad, until an injury closed that path. She went on to study kinesiology and spent more than ten years learning from Shiva Rea, Saul David Raye and Seane Corn. From 2005 to 2014 she directed the Exhale Center for Sacred Movement in Venice, California, and she later set up Kirana, her own 500-hour yoga school.

The chakras sit at the centre of her teaching. Her 2021 book from St. Martin's, Chakra Rituals, sets out a seven-week programme with a chakra for each week and daily breath, meditation and movement practices. With the house DJ Marques Wyatt she leads Deep Exhale, where a yoga class turns into a dance gathering. She also gives tarot readings, a practice she took up with her teacher Brenda Rose in 2018, offers Reiki, runs somatic sound rituals in Los Angeles and online, sells recorded courses, and leads retreats and trainings in the United States, Mexico and abroad.

books.title: Chakra Rituals: Awakening the Wild Woman Within
books.author: Cristi Christensen
books.description: A seven-week workbook that takes one chakra per week. Each week pairs a short explanation with daily breathing, meditation and yoga sequences, illustrated in colour.

courses.title: The Seven Flames: Winter Solstice Ritual Retreat
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat at Esalen in Big Sur around the winter solstice, moving through the seven chakras one by one. Days combine yoga, kundalini kriya, dance, writing and a solstice ritual, with singer Daphne Tse leading mantra and chakra toning.

courses.title: Wish Camp Mexico: A Retreat for Women
courses.description: Five nights for women at the Feronia retreat house near Tepoztlán, co-led with Alexa Fischer. The week brings together movement, sound, creative work, rest and setting intentions.

courses.title: Embody the Chakras
courses.description: A recorded course of 28 long practices, four for each chakra, meant to be followed over about seven months. Each chakra gets a vinyasa class, a restorative session, a breath and meditation sitting and a dance practice.

courses.title: You Are Magic: Awaken Your Power through Yoga, the Tarot and the Chakras
courses.description: A recorded course of 29 short videos linking each chakra with cards from the tarot. For every chakra there is a talk, a yoga class, a meditation and a dance session, and no earlier tarot knowledge is needed.

courses.title: Tarot Readings and Reiki Bundles
courses.description: Remote tarot sessions from a quick 15-minute question to an hour looking at the year ahead, sometimes with breath, mudra or meditation suggestions afterwards. Bundles add distance Reiki sessions to a reading.

courses.title: Thanksliving: An Online Somatic Sound Ritual
courses.description: A one-hour live session on Zoom before Thanksgiving with a short gratitude ritual, gentle breathing, grounding movement and a sound bath. A replay stays available for five days.
